title: Porcelain Mask
author: sleepwalker77
_fit: rotateX: degrees turning the model upright (its face to +Z); tilt: degrees more about X; the eye holes' centres go onto his eyes (the rest pose's eye bones), scaled to his eye spacing times scale, forward metres in front of them, lift metres up; bloodTriangles: the tear's mesh simplified to this many. Chosen with fit-check.mjs: 0.96 and 0.042 keep the hood's rim behind the mask's edge (1.4 mm) and his face 3.9 mm behind it through every clip.
